answerFrames: My name is...
You can call me...
self.tip: Nói tên đầy đủ, rồi thêm nickname nếu có để câu trả lời dài hơn 1 chút.
self.sampleAnswer: My name is Trinh Bao Khanh, but you can call me Khanh.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ neɪm ɪz Trinh Bao Khanh | bət juː kæn kɔːl mi Khanh/

self.q: How do you spell your name?
self.audioFile: 02 - How do you spell your name.wav
answerFrames: It is spelt K-H-A-N-H.
Sure, it is...
self.tip: Đọc từng chữ cái rõ ràng. Luyện bảng chữ cái tiếng Anh trước cho chắc.
self.sampleAnswer: Sure. It is spelt K-H-A-N-H, Khanh.
sampleAnswerIpa: /ʃʊr/
/ɪt ɪz spelt keɪ eɪtʃ eɪ en eɪtʃ | Khanh/

answerFrames: I am ... years old.
self.tip: Chỉ cần 1 câu. Có thể thêm 'I was born in ...' cho dài hơn.
self.sampleAnswer: I am twenty-five years old. I was born in 2001.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ æm ˈtwenti faɪv jɪrz oʊld/
/aɪ wəz bɔːrn ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd wʌn/

answerFrames: My birthday is on...
It is on the ... of ...
self.tip: Dùng giới từ 'on' + ngày tháng. Đọc ngày theo dạng số thứ tự (the 13th).
self.sampleAnswer: My birthday is on the 13th of June, 2001.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈbɝːθdeɪ ɪz ɑːn ðə ˌθɝːˈtiːnθ əv dʒuːn | tuː ˈθaʊzənd wʌn/

answerFrames: I come from... / I'm from...
I was born and raised in...
It's in the North / South of Vietnam. / It's in Central Vietnam.
It's a/an huge / small / modern / old / beautiful place.
hometown.tip: Theo source Lesson 18: nói quê ở đâu, vùng miền, rồi thêm 1 tính từ chung như crowded, busy, quiet hoặc scenic.
hometown.sampleAnswer: I come from Thanh Hoa, a province in the north-central part of Vietnam, but I live in Hanoi for work now.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ kʌm frəm Thanh Hoa | ə ˈprɑːvɪns ɪn ðə nɔːrθ ˈsentrəl pɑːrt əv Vietnam | bət aɪ lɪv ɪn Hanoi fər wɝːk naʊ/

hometown.q: What do you like about your hometown?
answerFrames: The good thing is...
What I like about my hometown is that...
It has a mild / very nice climate.
The air is fresh and people are friendly and welcoming.
hometown.tip: Chọn ý trong source: nhiều thứ để làm, nhiều bạn bè, khí hậu dễ chịu, an toàn, đồ ăn ngon hoặc giao thông hiện đại.
hometown.sampleAnswer: What I like most is that it is peaceful and the air is fresh. The people there are also really friendly.
sampleAnswerIpa: /wʌt aɪ laɪk moʊst | ɪz ðæt ɪt ɪz ˈpiːsfəl ænd ði er ɪz freʃ/
/ðə ˈpiːpəl ðer ɑːr ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈrɪəli ˈfrendli/

hometown.q: Is there anything you dislike about your hometown?
answerFrames: The trouble is...
What I don't like about my hometown is that...
The pollution is getting really bad.
Everything here is so expensive.
hometown.tip: Dùng 1 vấn đề từ source: polluted, noisy and crowded, bad transport, bad weather hoặc people have to pay a fortune.
hometown.sampleAnswer: The one thing I don't like is the summer, because it gets really hot in my hometown.
sampleAnswerIpa: /ðə wʌn θɪŋ aɪ doʊnt laɪk | ɪz ðə ˈsʌmər | bɪˈkɔːz ɪt gets ˈrɪəli hɑːt ɪn maɪ ˈhoʊmtaʊn/

hometown.q: Are there any lakes or rivers / woods or forests / hills or mountains in your hometown?
answerFrames: There are a few / some / a lot of... where I live.
My favourite / The most famous ... is...
There aren't any...
It only has parks, shopping malls, cinemas and high-rise buildings.
hometown.tip: Ghép danh từ + tính từ từ source: crystal clear / polluted water, huge forests, high / rocky mountains.
hometown.sampleAnswer: Yes, my hometown has both mountains and a beautiful beach, like Sam Son, which is a popular seaside resort.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | maɪ ˈhoʊmtaʊn hæz boʊθ ˈmaʊntənz ænd ə ˈbjuːtəfəl biːtʃ | laɪk Sam Son | wɪtʃ ɪz ə ˈpɑːpjələr ˈsiːsaɪd rɪˈzɔːrt/

answerFrames: I'm a/an ... at ...
I'm working as a/an ... at ...
I'm a student at ...
job.tip: Theo Lesson 7: trả lời job/student + place. Nếu đang đi học, nói trường/ngành thay vì cố nói nghề.
job.sampleAnswer: I'm a software developer at FPT IS, and I mainly build web applications for businesses.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪm ə ˈsɔːftwer dɪˈveləpər ət FPT IS | ænd aɪ ˈmeɪnli bɪld web ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃənz fər ˈbɪznəsɪz/

job.q: Are you a student or are you working?
job.audioFile: 07 - Are you a student or are you working.wav
answerFrames: I'm a student at...
I'm working as a/an ... at ...
I work / study at ...
job.tip: Chọn đúng 1 hướng: studying hoặc working. Thêm nơi học/làm để câu đầy đủ hơn.
job.sampleAnswer: I'm working. I'm a software developer at FPT IS, where I build web applications.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪm ˈwɝːkɪŋ/
/aɪm ə ˈsɔːftwer dɪˈveləpər ət FPT IS | wer aɪ bɪld web ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃənz/

job.q: What is your dream job? Why?
job.audioFile: 08 - What is your dream job - why.wav
answerFrames: My dream is to become a/an...
I want to be / become a/an...
It's a good job for me because...
It's hard work, but the pay is good.
job.tip: Lý do nên lấy từ source: like helping people, love working with children, well-paid job, get to meet people hoặc visit many countries.
job.sampleAnswer: My dream is to become a senior developer at an international company because the pay is good and I can keep improving my skills.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ driːm ɪz tə bɪˈkʌm ə ˈsiːnjər dɪˈveləpər ət ən ˌɪntərˈnæʃənəl ˈkʌmpəni | bɪˈkɔːz ðə peɪ ɪz ɡʊd ænd aɪ kæn kiːp ɪmˈpruːvɪŋ maɪ skɪlz/

hobbies.q: What do you often do in your free time?
hobbies.audioFile: 09 - What do you often do in your free time.wav
answerFrames: I often + Verb...
I enjoy / am into / am interested in...
I don't do anything special.
I'm not free at the weekend.
hobbies.tip: Dùng ý Lesson 13: have a picnic, come over to a friend's house, go out for dinner, go to the cinema hoặc go for coffee.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: I often hit the gym in my free time because it helps me stay healthy and reduce stress.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ˈɔːfən hɪt ðə dʒɪm ɪn maɪ friː taɪm | bɪˈkɔːz ɪt helps mi steɪ ˈhelθi ænd rɪˈduːs stres/

hobbies.q: What do you often do on the weekend?
hobbies.audioFile: 10 - What do you often do at the weekend.wav
answerFrames: At the weekend, I usually...
I often go out for dinner / go to the cinema / go for coffee.
I usually go away for the weekend.
I come over to my friend's house and watch a film together.
hobbies.tip: Bám source Weekend: nói hoạt động cụ thể, rồi thêm with my friends/family hoặc after school/work.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: At the weekend, I usually meet my friends to play badminton or visit new places and try different food.
sampleAnswerIpa: /æt ðə ˈwiːkend | aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli miːt maɪ frendz tə pleɪ ˈbædmɪntən | ɔːr ˈvɪzɪt nuː ˈpleɪsɪz ænd traɪ ˈdɪfrənt fuːd/

hobbies.q: Do you like sports? How often?
hobbies.audioFile: 11 - Do you like sports - how often.wav
answerFrames: Yes, I do. I play ... once / twice a week.
I work out / get some exercise / take walks.
It helps me keep in great shape.
No, I don't like doing anything too energetic.
hobbies.tip: Trả lời Yes/No + môn hoặc bài tập + tần suất: every day, often, sometimes, once/twice a week.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do. I play badminton with my friends once or twice a week to keep fit.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | aɪ duː/
/aɪ pleɪ ˈbædmɪntən wɪð maɪ frendz wʌns ɔːr twaɪs ə wiːk tə kiːp fɪt/

answerFrames: Yes, watching movies is a good way to relax.
No, I often spend my free time reading or listening to music instead.
hobbies.tip: Trả lời Yes/No + lý do ngắn. Đây là câu mở đầu, câu chi tiết ở dưới.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do. Watching movies is a good way to relax and chill out after work.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | aɪ duː/
/ˈwɑːtʃɪŋ ˈmuːviz ɪz ə ɡʊd weɪ tə rɪˈlæks ænd tʃɪl aʊt ˈæftər wɝːk/

hobbies.q: What kinds of movies do you like?
hobbies.audioFile: 13 - What kinds of films do you like.wav
answerFrames: I like comedy / action / romantic films because...
I'm a big fan of...
They are funny / interesting / relaxing.
hobbies.tip: Source hỏi film/movie; dùng một thể loại + lý do đơn giản, hoặc nối với 'watching films is a good way to relax'.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: I like comedy movies the most because they make me laugh and help me forget my worries.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ laɪk ˈkɑːmədi ˈmuːviz ðə moʊst | bɪˈkɔːz ðeɪ meɪk mi læf ænd help mi fərˈɡet maɪ ˈwɝːiz/

answerFrames: My favourite film is...
It's one of the funniest / most interesting / best films I've seen.
The story is good and the soundtrack is excellent.
It's worth seeing.
hobbies.tip: Nói tên phim + 1-2 nhận xét từ source: story, special effects, main character, music/soundtrack.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: My favorite movie is Home Alone. It is one of the funniest movies I've seen. If you want a good laugh, you should watch it.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈmuːvi ɪz Home Alone/
/ɪt ɪz wʌn əv ðə ˈfʌniəst ˈmuːviz aɪv siːn/
/ɪf juː wɑːnt ə ɡʊd læf | juː ʃʊd wɑːtʃ ɪt/

hobbies.audioFile: 16 - Do you like reading books - what do you like reading most.wav
answerFrames: Yes, I do.
I'm interested in reading books about animals / nature / culture / languages.
I'm really into reading books about...
hobbies.tip: Nếu trả lời Yes, thêm ngay chủ đề sách thích đọc nhất theo source.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: Yes, I am. I mostly read books about technology and software development because they help me improve my knowledge.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | aɪ æm/
/aɪ ˈmoʊstli riːd bʊks əˈbaʊt tekˈnɑːlədʒi ænd ˈsɔːftwer dɪˈveləpmənt | bɪˈkɔːz ðeɪ help mi ɪmˈpruːv maɪ ˈnɑːlɪdʒ/

hobbies.q: Do you like listening to music?
hobbies.audioFile: 17 - Do you like listening to music - what kind of music do you often listen to.wav
answerFrames: I'm keen on / fond of listening to music.
I often listen to my favourite songs when I'm relaxing / taking a shower / doing the chores.
I'm a big fan of...
hobbies.tip: Dùng đúng khung Lesson 13: thích nghe nhạc + thời điểm nghe. Nếu nói ca sĩ, thêm great/beautiful voice.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: Yes, I am. I often listen to pop and Vietnamese music, usually when I'm coding or working out at the gym.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | aɪ æm/
/aɪ ˈɔːfən ˈlɪsən tə pɑːp ænd Vietnamese ˈmjuːzɪk | ˈjuːʒuəli wen aɪm ˈkoʊdɪŋ ɔːr ˈwɝːkɪŋ aʊt ət ðə dʒɪm/

hobbies.audioFile: 18 - Do you like playing computer games - what is your favourite computer game.wav
answerFrames: Yes, I do. My favourite computer game is...
No, I don't really play games. I prefer...
hobbies.tip: Yes/No + tên game + lý do ngắn.
hobbies.sampleAnswer: Yes, but not very often. My favourite is League of Legends, though we're all working now, so we rarely have time to play.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | bət nɑːt ˈveri ˈɔːfən/
/maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ɪz League of Legends | ðoʊ wɪr ɔːl ˈwɝːkɪŋ naʊ | soʊ wi ˈrerli hæv taɪm tə pleɪ/

daily-routine.q: What time is it in your country?
daily-routine.audioFile: 19 - What time is it in your country.wav
answerFrames: It is ... o'clock.
It is quarter past / half past ...
It is quarter to ...
daily-routine.tip: Đọc giờ đơn giản bằng số cũng được (seven fifteen).
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: It is about half past nine in the morning now.
sampleAnswerIpa: /ɪt ɪz əˈbaʊt hæf pæst naɪn ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ naʊ/

daily-routine.q: What time do you get up?
daily-routine.audioFile: 20 - What time do you get up.wav
answerFrames: I usually get up at ... in the morning.
daily-routine.tip: Dùng Present Simple + 'at + giờ'. Thêm 'around/about' khi không chắc.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I usually get up at around six thirty in the morning.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ɡet ʌp ət əˈraʊnd sɪks ˈθɝːti ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/

daily-routine.q: What time do you go to school/work?
daily-routine.audioFile: 21 - What time do you go to school or work.wav
answerFrames: I go to school/work at ...
I leave home at ...
daily-routine.tip: Ghép 'activity + at + time'. Có thể thêm thời gian ăn sáng.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I go to school at seven, so I have about thirty minutes to have breakfast first.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ɡoʊ tə skuːl ət ˈsevən | soʊ aɪ hæv əˈbaʊt ˈθɝːti ˈmɪnɪts tə hæv ˈbrekfəst fɝːst/

daily-routine.q: What time do you have breakfast/lunch/dinner?
daily-routine.audioFile: 22 - What time do you have breakfast.wav
answerFrames: I have breakfast at ...
I have lunch at ...
I have dinner at ...
daily-routine.tip: Nói bữa ăn + at + giờ. Có thể thêm ăn ở đâu hoặc với ai.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I have breakfast at around six forty-five, lunch at twelve and dinner at seven with my family.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ hæv ˈbrekfəst ət əˈraʊnd sɪks ˌfɔːrti ˈfaɪv | lʌntʃ ət twelv | ænd ˈdɪnər ət ˈsevən wɪð maɪ ˈfæməli/

daily-routine.q: What time do you come home from school/work?
daily-routine.audioFile: 25 - What time do you come home from school or work.wav
answerFrames: I come home at / around ... in the afternoon.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I usually come home at around five in the afternoon.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli kʌm hoʊm ət əˈraʊnd faɪv ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnuːn/

daily-routine.q: What time do you go to bed?
daily-routine.audioFile: 26 - What time do you go to bed.wav
answerFrames: I go to bed at about ... at night.
daily-routine.tip: Thêm việc làm trước khi ngủ (do homework, watch YouTube).
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I go to bed at about eleven at night, after I finish my homework.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ɡoʊ tə bed ət əˈbaʊt ɪˈlevən ət naɪt | ˈæftər aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ maɪ ˈhoʊmwɝːk/

answerFrames: I go to school/work by bus / bike / motorbike.
I walk because it is near my house.
It takes me about ... minutes.
daily-routine.tip: Dùng 'by + phương tiện' (không có 'a'). Thêm mất bao lâu.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I go to school by motorbike. It takes me about fifteen minutes to get there.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ɡoʊ tə skuːl baɪ ˈmoʊtərbaɪk/
/ɪt teɪks mi əˈbaʊt ˌfɪfˈtiːn ˈmɪnɪts tə ɡet ðer/

daily-routine.q: How often do you phone your friend?

answerFrames: I call my best friend once / twice a week.
We chat about school and movies.
daily-routine.tip: Tần suất + nói chuyện về gì.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I chat with my friends online almost every day. We usually make plans to go out for drinks or play badminton together.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ tʃæt wɪð maɪ frendz ˈɑːnlaɪn ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈevri deɪ/
/wi ˈjuːʒuəli meɪk plænz tə ɡoʊ aʊt fər drɪŋks ɔːr pleɪ ˈbædmɪntən təˈɡeðər/

daily-routine.q: How often do you clean the house?
answerFrames: I clean the house once / twice a week.
I usually tidy my room on the weekend.
I help my mum with the housework.
daily-routine.tip: Tần suất + việc cụ thể: clean the house, tidy my room, do the washing-up.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I clean the house once a week, usually on the weekend. I tidy my room and sometimes help my mum do the washing-up.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ kliːn ðə haʊs wʌns ə wiːk | ˈjuːʒuəli ɑːn ðə ˈwiːkend/
/aɪ ˈtaɪdi maɪ ruːm ænd ˈsʌmtaɪmz help maɪ mʌm duː ðə ˌwɑːʃɪŋ ˈʌp/

daily-routine.q: How often do you read the newspaper?
answerFrames: I rarely read newspapers.
I usually read the news online.
I read the news on my phone every morning.
daily-routine.tip: Có thể nói thật: bây giờ ít đọc báo giấy, thường đọc tin tức online.
daily-routine.sampleAnswer: I rarely read printed newspapers, but I read the news online on my phone almost every day.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ ˈrerli riːd ˈprɪntɪd ˈnuːzˌpeɪpərz | bət aɪ riːd ðə nuːz ˈɑːnlaɪn ɑːn maɪ foʊn ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈevri deɪ/

daily-routine.sampleAnswer: My friends come over about twice a month. We usually play games, have a few beers and chat together.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ frendz kʌm ˈoʊvər əˈbaʊt twaɪs ə mʌnθ/
/wi ˈjuːʒuəli pleɪ ɡeɪmz | hæv ə fjuː bɪrz | ænd tʃæt təˈɡeðər/

family.q: Do you live in a big family?

answerFrames: No, I'm an only child. It's just me and my parents.

answerFrames: My father / mother is a/an...
He / She works as a/an ... at ...
family.tip: Nói nghề của bố/mẹ + có thể thêm nơi làm.

answerFrames: He / She is very interested in...

sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈfɑːðər ɪz ˈrɪəli ˈɪntu ˈɡɑːrdənɪŋ ɪn hɪz friː taɪm | waɪl maɪ ˈmʌðər ɪnˈdʒɔɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ fər ə wɔːk tə kiːp fɪt/

appearance.q: What does he / she look like?
appearance.audioFile: 32 - What does he or she look like.wav
answerFrames: He / She is in his / her twenties / thirties / forties.
He / She is young / middle-aged / old.
He / She is of average height and quite slim / well-built.
He / She is handsome / pretty / good-looking / average-looking.
appearance.tip: Tả theo Lesson 8: age -> general look -> height/weight/build -> face/hair. Không cần nói quá nhiều.
appearance.sampleAnswer: My father is about fifty. He is around one metre sixty-nine, and he has short black hair with a few grey strands.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈfɑːðər ɪz əˈbaʊt ˈfɪfti/
/hi ɪz əˈraʊnd wʌn ˈmiːtər ˈsɪksti naɪn | ænd hi hæz ʃɔːrt blæk her wɪð ə fjuː ɡreɪ strændz/

appearance.q: What kind of hair does he / she have?
appearance.audioFile: 33 - What kind of hair does he or she have.wav
answerFrames: He / She has got long straight black hair.
He / She has got short / shoulder-length / wavy / curly hair.
He / She has got brown / blue eyes.
He / She has got glasses / a beard / a moustache.
appearance.tip: Thứ tự tóc theo source: độ dài + kiểu + màu, ví dụ long straight black hair.
appearance.sampleAnswer: My father has short black hair with a few grey strands, while my mother has long straight black hair.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈfɑːðər hæz ʃɔːrt blæk her wɪð ə fjuː ɡreɪ strændz | waɪl maɪ ˈmʌðər hæz lɔːŋ streɪt blæk her/

appearance.q: What kinds of clothes does he / she often wear?
appearance.audioFile: 34 - What kinds of clothes does he or she often wear.wav
answerFrames: He / She often wears...
He / She often wears shirts / T-shirts / a pair of jeans / casual clothes.
appearance.tip: Chỉ cần nói loại quần áo thường mặc theo Lesson 8; có thể thêm at work/at home nếu muốn rõ hơn.
appearance.sampleAnswer: He often wears a shirt and a pair of jeans. At work, he usually wears more formal clothes.
sampleAnswerIpa: /hi ˈɔːfən werz ə ʃɝːt ænd ə per əv dʒiːnz/
/æt wɝːk | hi ˈjuːʒuəli werz mɔːr ˈfɔːrməl kloʊðz/

personality.audioFile: 35 - What is he or she like.wav
answerFrames: He / She is + adjective + explanation.
He is really neat. He always keeps things tidy.
She is great to be with. She makes me laugh all the time.
He / She is friendly and easy to talk to.
personality.tip: Công thức Lesson 10: tính từ + 1 câu giải thích hành động/thói quen. Đừng chỉ nói 1 adjective.
personality.sampleAnswer: My father is kind and responsible. He always takes good care of the family and never lets us down.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈfɑːðər ɪz kaɪnd ænd rɪˈspɑːnsəbəl/
/hi ˈɔːlweɪz teɪks ɡʊd ker əv ðə ˈfæməli ænd ˈnevər lets ʌs daʊn/

personality.q: Is he / she friendly, talkative, humorous or generous?
personality.audioFile: 36 - Is he or she friendly talkative humorous or generous.wav
answerFrames: He / She is really / so / very + adjective.
He / She is quite / pretty / kind of + adjective.
He / She is not + adjective + at all.
He / She is kind and generous / outgoing and sociable / shy and not very talkative.
personality.tip: Dùng mức độ từ source: really/so/very hoặc quite/pretty/kind of, rồi thêm ví dụ ngắn.
personality.sampleAnswer: My mother is really patient and caring. She always listens to me and looks after everyone in the family.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈmʌðər ɪz ˈrɪəli ˈpeɪʃənt ænd ˈkerɪŋ/
/ʃi ˈɔːlweɪz ˈlɪsənz tə mi ænd lʊks ˈæftər ˈevriwʌn ɪn ðə ˈfæməli/

house.q: What is your favorite room in your house?
house.audioFile: 38 - What is your favourite room in your house.wav
answerFrames: My favorite room is my bedroom because...
My favorite room is the kitchen. I love cooking.
My favorite room is the living room. I can spend time with my family.
house.tip: Chọn 1 phòng + lý do (thoải mái, được làm gì ở đó).
house.sampleAnswer: My favorite room is my bedroom because I feel free and comfortable there. I can study, listen to music and watch movies.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ruːm ɪz maɪ ˈbedruːm bɪˈkɔːz aɪ fiːl friː ænd ˈkʌmftəbəl ðer/
/aɪ kæn ˈstʌdi | ˈlɪsən tə ˈmjuːzɪk | ænd wɑːtʃ ˈmuːviz/

house.q: Can you describe your living room / bedroom / kitchen?
house.audioFile: 39 - Can you describe your living room bedroom or kitchen.wav
answerFrames: It is comfortable, but pretty small. / It is really big.
There is a desk, a chair, a bed and a wardrobe.
My bed is in the middle. The table is next to the bed.
house.tip: Dùng There is/are + giới từ vị trí (in the middle of, next to, on the wall).
house.sampleAnswer: My bedroom is comfortable but pretty small. It is painted in blue. There is a bed in the middle, a desk next to the window and some pictures on the wall.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈbedruːm ɪz ˈkʌmftəbəl bət ˈprɪti smɔːl/
/ɪt ɪz ˈpeɪntɪd ɪn bluː/
/ðer ɪz ə bed ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl | ə desk nekst tə ðə ˈwɪndoʊ | ænd sʌm ˈpɪktʃərz ɑːn ðə wɔːl/

answerFrames: Yes, definitely, because I can relax.
Yes, because I can spend time with my family / friends and gain new experience.
No, I don't, because I don't have enough money / time.
trip.tip: Lấy lý do từ Lesson 14: relax, spend time with family/friends, learn new things, gain new experience, not enough money/time.
trip.sampleAnswer: Yes, definitely. I love traveling because I can visit new places and try different food.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | ˈdefɪnətli/
/aɪ lʌv ˈtrævəlɪŋ bɪˈkɔːz aɪ kæn ˈvɪzɪt nuː ˈpleɪsɪz ænd traɪ ˈdɪfrənt fuːd/

trip.q: Tell me about one trip you remember the most.
trip.audioFile: 41 - Tell me about one trip you remember the most.wav
answerFrames: The trip I remember the most is the trip to...
I went there ... ago with my family / friends.
We went there by car / train / plane and it took us about...
It was great / wonderful / fantastic / so-so / terrible.
trip.tip: Khung source: đi đâu -> khi nào -> đi với ai -> phương tiện -> làm gì -> cảm nhận. Dùng Past Simple.
trip.sampleAnswer: The trip I remember the most is my recent trip to Nha Trang. I went there with my girlfriend. We went sightseeing, swam at the beach and enjoyed a lot of fresh seafood. It was wonderful and I had a great time.
sampleAnswerIpa: /ðə trɪp aɪ rɪˈmembər ðə moʊst | ɪz maɪ ˈriːsənt trɪp tə Nha Trang/
/aɪ went ðer wɪð maɪ ˈɡɝːlfrend/
/wi went ˈsaɪtˌsiːɪŋ | swæm ət ðə biːtʃ | ænd ɪnˈdʒɔɪd ə lɑːt əv freʃ ˈsiːfuːd/
/ɪt wəz ˈwʌndərfəl ænd aɪ hæd ə ɡreɪt taɪm/

trip.q: Tell me about one trip you want to take in the future.
trip.audioFile: 42 - Tell me about one trip you want to take in the future.wav
answerFrames: If I had a chance, I would love to visit...
I am going to visit... with...
We are going to travel by... and stay at...
I hope I will have a wonderful time.
trip.tip: Source chủ yếu là trip đã nhớ; với future trip dùng lại khung place -> people -> transport -> activities -> feeling.
trip.sampleAnswer: I am going to visit Switzerland because I love its high mountains, clear lakes and peaceful small towns. I am going to go with my girlfriend and travel from Germany by train, since it is comfortable and we can enjoy the views along the way. We are going to stay at a small, cosy hotel by a lake, walk around the towns and try Swiss chocolate and cheese. I think the train trip will be amazing.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ æm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈvɪzɪt Switzerland | bɪˈkɔːz aɪ lʌv ɪts haɪ ˈmaʊntənz | klɪr leɪks | ænd ˈpiːsfəl smɔːl taʊnz/
/aɪ æm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ɡoʊ wɪð maɪ ˈɡɝːlfrend ænd ˈtrævəl frəm Germany baɪ treɪn | sɪns ɪt ɪz ˈkʌmftəbəl ænd wi kæn ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ðə vjuːz əˈlɔːŋ ðə weɪ/
/wi ɑːr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə steɪ ət ə smɔːl ˈkoʊzi hoʊˈtel baɪ ə leɪk | wɔːk əˈraʊnd ðə taʊnz | ænd traɪ Swiss ˈtʃɑːklət ænd tʃiːz/
/aɪ θɪŋk ðə treɪn trɪp wɪl bi əˈmeɪzɪŋ/

food-restaurant.q: What are your favorite foods/drinks? Are they good for you?
food-restaurant.audioFile: 43 - What are your favourite foods or drinks - are they good for you.wav
answerFrames: My favourite dish / drink is...
It is pretty good / tasty / delicious.
It is healthy because...
It is too salty / oily / sweet, so it may not be good for me.
food-restaurant.tip: Lesson 16 tập trung nhận xét món ăn: tasty/delicious, fresh, salty, oily, terrible hoặc awful.
food-restaurant.sampleAnswer: My favorite dish is pho. I don't think it is very healthy because the broth is quite salty, but I love it, so I have it once a week.
sampleAnswerIpa: /maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt dɪʃ ɪz pho/
/aɪ doʊnt θɪŋk ɪt ɪz ˈveri ˈhelθi | bɪˈkɔːz ðə brɔːθ ɪz kwaɪt ˈsɔːlti | bət aɪ lʌv ɪt | soʊ aɪ hæv ɪt wʌns ə wiːk/

food-restaurant.q: Do you like eating out? How often do you go to a restaurant?
food-restaurant.audioFile: 44 - Do you like eating out - how often do you go to a restaurant.wav
answerFrames: Yes, I do. I go to a restaurant once / twice a month.
We went to a steak / seafood / fast food restaurant near my hotel / in the city centre.
To start the meal, we had...
The main dish was... For dessert, we ordered...
food-restaurant.tip: Nếu kể nhà hàng, theo Lesson 16: loại nhà hàng + ở đâu + món khai vị + món chính + tráng miệng + nhận xét đồ ăn.
food-restaurant.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do. The restaurant I remember the most is a seafood place in Nha Trang, near my hotel. To start, we had crab soup, and for the main dishes we had steamed lobster, grilled oysters and steamed squid, which were all very fresh. For dessert, we had ice cream. The food was delicious, the staff were friendly, and the meal for two only cost about one million dong, so I would definitely go there again.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | aɪ duː/
/ðə ˈrestərɑːnt aɪ rɪˈmembər ðə moʊst | ɪz ə ˈsiːfuːd pleɪs ɪn Nha Trang | nɪr maɪ hoʊˈtel/
/tə stɑːrt | wi hæd kræb suːp | ænd fər ðə meɪn ˈdɪʃɪz wi hæd stiːmd ˈlɑːbstər | ɡrɪld ˈɔɪstərz | ænd stiːmd skwɪd | wɪtʃ wər ɔːl ˈveri freʃ/
/fər dɪˈzɝːt | wi hæd aɪs kriːm/
/ðə fuːd wəz dɪˈlɪʃəs | ðə stæf wər ˈfrendli | ænd ðə miːl fər tuː ˈoʊnli kɔːst əˈbaʊt wʌn ˈmɪljən dong | soʊ aɪ wʊd ˈdefɪnətli ɡoʊ ðer əˈɡen/

health-illness.q: Do you have a healthy diet?
answerFrames: Yes, definitely. I eat a lot of fruit and vegetables.
I do exercise every day, go to sleep early and drink enough water.
No, I don't. I eat a lot of fast food and drink soft drinks.
I'm too lazy, so I don't do exercise every day.
health-illness.tip: Source hỏi healthy lifestyle; với câu diet, ưu tiên nói ăn rau quả, uống đủ nước, không ăn fast food/soft drinks.
health-illness.sampleAnswer: Yes, I think so. I try to eat a lot of vegetables and fruit every day, and I don't skip breakfast. I love fast food, but I only eat it once or twice a month.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | aɪ θɪŋk soʊ/
/aɪ traɪ tə iːt ə lɑːt əv ˈvedʒtəbəlz ænd fruːt ˈevri deɪ | ænd aɪ doʊnt skɪp ˈbrekfəst/
/aɪ lʌv fæst fuːd | bət aɪ ˈoʊnli iːt ɪt wʌns ɔːr twaɪs ə mʌnθ/

health-illness.q: Do you exercise? What exercise do you do?
answerFrames: Yes, I like swimming, jogging and cycling.
I go to the gym / play football / play badminton.
They're really good for you.
No, I don't do exercise every day.
health-illness.tip: Theo Lesson 19: Yes/No + bài tập cụ thể. Có thể thêm 'They're really good for you'.
health-illness.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do. I go to the gym regularly and play badminton with my friends at the weekend to keep in shape.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | aɪ duː/
/aɪ ɡoʊ tə ðə dʒɪm ˈreɡjələrli ænd pleɪ ˈbædmɪntən wɪð maɪ frendz ət ðə ˈwiːkend tə kiːp ɪn ʃeɪp/

answerFrames: Yes, especially before an exam.
When I feel stressed, I usually listen to music or take a walk.
Sleep helps a lot.
health-illness.tip: Yes/No + khi nào bị + cách giải toả.
health-illness.sampleAnswer: Yes, especially when I have to work under pressure. When I feel stressed, I usually go to the gym or listen to music to relax.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | ɪˈspeʃəli wen aɪ hæv tə wɝːk ˈʌndər ˈpreʃər/
/wen aɪ fiːl strest | aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ɡoʊ tə ðə dʒɪm ɔːr ˈlɪsən tə ˈmjuːzɪk tə rɪˈlæks/

health-illness.q: What should you do if you have a headache/toothache?
answerFrames: If you have a headache, you should rest / take aspirin / see the doctor / stop using the computer.
If you have a toothache, you should go to the dentist.
You shouldn't stay up late.
health-illness.tip: Dùng đúng mẫu source: have a headache -> rest/take aspirin/see the doctor; have a toothache -> go to the dentist.
health-illness.sampleAnswer: If you have a headache, you should take some painkillers and rest. If you have a toothache, you should see a dentist.
sampleAnswerIpa: /ɪf juː hæv ə ˈhedeɪk | juː ʃʊd teɪk sʌm ˈpeɪnˌkɪlərz ænd rest/
/ɪf juː hæv ə ˈtuːθeɪk | juː ʃʊd siː ə ˈdentɪst/

health-illness.q: What should you do if you have got a cold?
answerFrames: If you have got a cold, you should rest.
You should go to bed with a hot drink.
You should stay at home and drink enough water.
health-illness.tip: Source Lesson 19: have got a cold -> rest hoặc go to bed with a hot drink. Giữ câu ngắn, dễ nói.
health-illness.sampleAnswer: If you have got a cold, you should stay at home, drink hot water with honey and wear a mask so you don't infect others.
sampleAnswerIpa: /ɪf juː hæv ɡɑːt ə koʊld | juː ʃʊd steɪ ət hoʊm | drɪŋk hɑːt ˈwɔːtər wɪð ˈhʌni | ænd wer ə mæsk soʊ juː doʊnt ɪnˈfekt ˈʌðərz/

shopping.q: Do you like shopping? Why or why not?
shopping.audioFile: 45 - Do you like shopping - why or why not.wav
answerFrames: Yes, I do, because it is relaxing.
No, I don't, because it is tiring.
shopping.tip: Yes/No + 1 lý do (thư giãn / mệt / tốn tiền).
shopping.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do. Shopping is relaxing for me, especially when I go with my friends at the weekend.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | aɪ duː/
/ˈʃɑːpɪŋ ɪz rɪˈlæksɪŋ fər mi | ɪˈspeʃəli wen aɪ ɡoʊ wɪð maɪ frendz ət ðə ˈwiːkend/

shopping.q: What kind of shops do you like? Why or why not?
shopping.audioFile: 46 - What kind of shops do you like - why or why not.wav
answerFrames: I like clothes / book / sports shops because...
I prefer shopping malls because everything is in one place.
shopping.tip: Nói loại cửa hàng + lý do. Từ hay: reasonable price, a wide range of...
shopping.sampleAnswer: I like bookshops the most because I can spend hours there. I also like clothes shops when they have reasonable prices.
sampleAnswerIpa: /aɪ laɪk ˈbʊkʃɑːps ðə moʊst | bɪˈkɔːz aɪ kæn spend ˈaʊərz ðer/
/aɪ ˈɔːlsoʊ laɪk kloʊðz ʃɑːps wen ðeɪ hæv ˈriːzənəbəl ˈpraɪsɪz/
